overview:
Dr. Coral Wille received a PhD in Microbiology at the University of Wisconsin-Madison, and then completed postdoctoral research at the Wisconsin Institute for Discovery (UW-Madison). Dr. Wille's training has focused on epigenetic regulation of cell fate and tumor viruses. 

Dr. Wille recently joined UAB and started her lab in 2023. The Wille Lab interrogates the molecular underpinnings of development and transformation using dynamic reprogramming model systems.

For more information and to learn about opportunities in the Wille lab, please visit https://sites.uab.edu/willelab/
